certificateQuestion1: 1. I have installed the certificate but it still says not installed?
certificateQuestion1Android:
- Certificate may not be installed successfully. You can check whether the installed certificate can be found in the system settings `Trusted Credentials` list. 
- It may be that different versions of certificates are installed. It is recommended to compare and check the fingerprint to confirm that it is the same certificate.
certificateQuestion1Ios: It may be that different versions of certificates are installed. It is recommended to compare and check the fingerprint to confirm that it is the same certificate.
certificateQuestion2: 2. Successfully installed the certificate but unable to analyze HTTPS traffic?
certificateQuestion2Android: Check whether the project has enabled certificate pinning or two-way authentication. In these cases, HTTPS traffic cannot be analyzed.
certificateQuestion2Ios:
- The certificate is not set to full trust. Please check whether trust is enabled for the Reqable certificate in the system certificate trust settings.
- Check whether the project has enabled certificate pinning or two-way authentication. In these cases, HTTPS traffic cannot be analyzed.
